<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-APP-005</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Dashboards, rules and reports</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Rule node debug events; integration status; server log</b></div></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>secret &#x27;NAME&#x27; does not exist</span></div>

## Why it happens

The configuration uses `${secret:NAME}`, but no secret with that name exists for the tenant that owns the configuration. It was renamed, deleted, or created in another tenant.

## Fix it

Add the secret under **Security > Secrets** with exactly that name, or change the reference in the configuration.

## Check that it worked

The rule node or integration works again. A changed secret is used within a minute.
